commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add echo
commitResults.messageBody: Echo repeats the user's commands until the command `bye` is issued.

refactor: Modify greet & farewell to use echo
commitResults.messageBody: Reduce code duplication.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Modify list to use echo & StringBuilder
commitResults.messageBody:
StringBuilder is mutatble unlike the String wrapper class. This allows
for dynamic modification of the string. List uses echo to reduce code
duplication.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Update README.md on AI use
commitResults.messageBody: Include codex use in code generation & reformat AI usage section.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add mark command
commitResults.messageBody:
Update task status without using additional classes. Changes by Codex as
per step 1 of Level-3 of ip AI Guidance section.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add unmark command
commitResults.messageBody:
Unmark command updates task status, without using additional classes.
Changes made by Codex as per ip Level-3 step 2 AI guidance section.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Modify mark & unmark to use Task class
commitResults.messageBody:
Closely model OOP methodology of modeling using objects. Task class
allows for abstraction, encapsulation & separation of concerns. This
more closely follows SOLID principles. However, this introduces some
overhead. Code changes are made by Codex according to step 3 of ip AI
guidance section.

commitResults.messageBody: Include test-ui skill to help AI check it's own work.

commitResults.messageBody: For AI agents to be familiar with the UI test plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Modify Task class to use toString
commitResults.messageBody:
This change allows the responsibility of displaying the task to be isolated
to the task object. Removal of unused getters.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Modify add to use Task
commitResults.messageBody: Responsibility of Task creation does not belong to the add method.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add Todo
commitResults.messageBody:
Allows the creation of task of type Todo. Remove unused getDescription
method.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add Deadline

Add Deadline task type, allows for the inclusion of a deadline in the
task.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add Event

Add test cases to handle possible errors with commands. Changes made by

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add error handling via EchoException
commitResults.messageBody:
Catch errors via EchoException. Replace previous if-else statements with
try-catch. Abstraction of command processing. Some changes are made by Codex.

commitResults.messageBody:
Intention to change error messages& changed ui test plan accordingly.
Changes made by Codex.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Add EchoException subclasses
commitResults.messageBody:
Move responsibility of storing the different kinds of error messages to
the different EchoException subclasses. Simplify validation & error
handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: test: Update test ui plan with edge cases
commitResults.messageBody:
Add more test cases to cover edge cases and incorrect inputs. Interleave
positive & negative test cases to detect incorrect inputs affecting the
correctness of the internal states.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: Modify Echo to use ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody:
Allows for dynamic resizing of the array. Removes the possibility of
exceeding the size of the allocated array. MemoryLimitExceededException
is no longer needed.
